message.content: [罪名]非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护的野生动物罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: illegal capture of protected animals (frogs) that are national protected species. In Chinese criminal law, illegal hunting, killing, or trading of protected wildlife is punishable under "非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护的野生动物罪" (illegal hunting, killing of protected wildlife). The specific article: Criminal Law Article 341? Actually Article 341 deals with illegal hunting, killing, trading of protected wildlife. The crime is "非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护的野生动物罪". Also possibly "非法收购、运输、出售国家重点保护的野生动物罪". But here only capture, not sale. So the crime is illegal hunting of protected wildlife. Also maybe "破坏国家重点保护的野生动物及其栖息地罪"? But capture is illegal hunting. So one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护的野生动物罪<eoa>
